rationale: q is clocked by div through an exact alias, local_clk. The SDC declares div as a 20 ns clock and puts it in no group with src_clk. sampled captures q directly in src_clk with no relationship established. The capture is safe if the clocks are synchronous and unsafe if they are asynchronous, and the inputs do not say which.
caveats: CST-004 (unknown pair or crossing) and CDC-003 (WARNING Unresolved for an Unknown relation) are the required disclosures. Do not infer frequency locking from the 20/10 ns periods.
local_clk is an exact alias of the top-level input div, not a generated clock. CDC-002 and CDC-030 should not fire and are not credited.
Raw rst_n release on both domains is unestablished, as the contract states.

Physical timing and metastability requirements remain external.
